# Temporal Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.temporal.service` |
| Source | `09_docker/docker.temporal.service.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, workers |

Temporal auto-setup server backed by PostgreSQL. Provides durable workflow execution
for the worker services. Dynamic config is mounted from ./dynamicconfig.

### Inputs

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POSTGRES_USER` | `string` | yes | `-` | PostgreSQL user used by Temporal |
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | `string` | yes | `-` | PostgreSQL password used by Temporal |
| `POSTGRES_SEEDS` | `string` | yes | `-` | Comma-separated PostgreSQL host seeds (default pgvector) |
| `TEMPORAL_PORT` | `string` | no | `7233` | Host port to expose the Temporal frontend gRPC API (default 7233) |
| `DB_PORT` | `string` | no | `5432` | PostgreSQL port Temporal connects to (default 5432) |
